_doc: Allowed levers for the nightly experiment loop (experiment_loop.py). ONLY these levers and values can ever be applied. Order = test queue. Every value must render cleanly (hook/cta '' = no card; music_volume is the documentary music bed, default config.DOC_MUSIC_VOLUME 0.10).

levers.hypothesis: Dropping the 1.8s hook title card (straight into the spoken cold open) raises avg % watched; research says a cold open beats a title card.
Ending on the payoff line with no end card raises avg % watched (viewers leave at the outro).
A quieter music bed makes the narration clearer and raises avg % watched.
